QUESTION OF ZAKAT : Please advise is it permitted to give Zakat money to the Muslim Parents of a Child with the intention that the money be used to make their child study in a school which along with the Deeneyat , Hifz ,etc also teaches English and other related subjects of CBSE course . 1747 views Q. I had purchased land(present value 9 lacs) 2 years back with the intention of selling it later for purchasing a flat for myself or build a house on that land in future or use it as my retirement savings. 1) Do i need to pay zakat on this land? 2) If answer to 1) is No, last year I kept aside zakat money for this land but not yet given it. I have given some loans to my friends and brothers in 2015. Date of repayment is not certain. They will pay it once they become capable for. But there is 100% hope that they will pay it. What is the ruling for zakah on such receivables? 2190 views Q. My question is about Zakat. I pay zakat ever year and like to pick one or two families who can benefit the most from it. However, as it happens, the zakat fulfills their temporary needs. They spend money quickly and are again in need (for example widows, children, etc). Many do not know how to make good use of money (to start a small business, open a shop, etc). 1. Can I invest the money (amount of annual zakat) on behalf of the needy and pay them the profit (they remain the owners of capital and can take it from me anytime)? 2. My father runs a trust. The trust makes investments in businesses and the profits are used for charity purposes. Can I pay my zakat to his trust? Can the trust invest my zakat and pay the profit in charity? 3. Can the trust open a separate account of investments for Zakat, invest it and help the needy and poor with the profits generated? Would really appreciate your answers. 1608 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1951 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 37700 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I have three pieces of land. On one piece of land, I have decided to establish a Hifzul Quran Madrasa, and as for the other two pieces Question: I have three pieces of land. On one piece of land, I have decided to establish a Hifzul Quran Madrasa, and as for the other two pieces, my plan is that if my money is not enough for the construction of the madrasa, I will sell those to meet the cost. Am I to give zakah on these three pieces of land? Answer ID: 37700 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 53/44/N=1433) In the question mentioned above, there is no zakah on any of the three pieces of land. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
